literal: Wealth having lost, those who have forgotten themselves, they say, compassion having abandoned, evil deeds doing, those who conduct themselves.
translation: Those who abandon compassion and live committing evil deeds are like those who have lost their wealth and fallen into mindless ruin, say the wise.
modern: அருள் இல்லாமல் தீமைகளைச் செய்து வாழ்பவர்களை, செல்வத்தை இழந்து தம்மை மறந்தவர்கள் என்று அறிஞர்கள் கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet compares the spiritual loss of compassion to the worldly loss of wealth. Those who live without compassion and commit harmful deeds are equated to people who have lost all their wealth and are living in a state of mindless negligence. The word 'பொச்சாந்தார்' highlights how a lack of grace makes one forgetful of virtue and human dignity. Thus, compassion is presented as the essential wealth that keeps a person mindful and righteous.
